title: Test startup health and static assets on Ubuntu 24.04 VPS
description: Run the final artifact on the approved Ubuntu 24.04 test path and verify startup, health, localized protected routes, embedded assets, and low-resource behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: Ubuntu 24.04 host metadata and resource constraints are recorded without secrets
The artifact starts on Node 22 without a source build and reaches health/readiness
English and Persian login/protected routes load, and required JS/CSS/media assets return successful responses
A representative API operation and shutdown/restart complete without OOM or leaked processes

steps.details: Confirm OS/architecture/resources/runtime/artifact digest and disposable data paths using the approved access method.
Start the service, wait for readiness, query health, and record timings/status without response secrets.
Use browser/API smoke checks for en/fa protected routes and required assets; fail on 404/MIME/unprotected-shell failures.
Exercise a safe representative operation, restart, and cleanup; record process/resource results and unresolved limitations.

technicalNotes: Do not mark this passed based on local Windows results or Docker configuration; Ubuntu host evidence is required.
